dedupe_keys.name: dns over https generated browser and real backbone traffic collection

description: This collection combines DNS-over-HTTPS traffic generated with Firefox and Chrome with anonymised observations from CESNET backbone links. Brno University of Technology and CESNET researchers publish seven coordinated deposits, covering selected resolver groups and a real-network capture. The real component spans about ten days and 420 million connections; generated components vary browser and resolver settings. Zenodo distributes PCAP traffic, TLS-enriched CSV flows and resolver lists in compressed archives free under CC BY 4.0, with a separate preparation-code deposit. Coverage concerns selected clients and one national academic network, with exact capture dates unestablished. Anonymisation and selected resolvers are limitations for later protocol deployments. A reviewer-assessed use is checking encrypted-DNS workload and classification assumptions in network simulations. data-cesnet-backbone-traffic-datasets is related but explicitly covers different named collections. All seven deposits are treated as one parent resource. No packet captures, resolver queries or generation scripts were downloaded or executed.
